title: Utility-weighted reservoir sampling for mini calibration bundles (per-domain)
creator: Priya Nair
description: Design and implement a production-ready sampling strategy to generate compact, per-domain calibration packs for FP8/INT8 quantization validation. The goal is to produce small (1-5k) domain-aware mini-bundles that preserve functional coverage, recent traffic characteristics, and privacy constraints while assigning a utility weight per prompt for reservoir-based selection. These packs will feed the calibration workflow and the accuracy validation suite used by the quantization pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline takes a tenant/domain and outputs a <5k prompt calibration bundle with metadata (semantic cluster, recency score, token-length bucket, utility score)
Bundles achieve >=95% recall of high-importance intents measured by held-out importance scorer (ENG-98765 reference) for the domain
Calibration runs (FP8, INT8) using generated bundles show no regression >1% BLEU/ROUGE-equivalent metric on evaluation prompts compared to baseline calibration data
Privacy-preserving mode removes PII according to the redact policy and produces a signed manifest; security review sign-off obtained
implementation_notes: Compute per-prompt utility = alpha * log(token_count + 1) + beta * recency_decay + gamma * intent_importance, coefficients configurable per customer
Reservoir sampling uses utility-weighted probabilities; implement alias table for O(1) updates when streaming logs
Semantic clusters computed with embeddings (rk-512) and approximate k-means; clusters used to enforce minimum per-cluster quotas
Enforce per-tenant class quotas: max 60% of bundle from any single user/customer to avoid fingerprinting
Support a deterministic seed derived from domain id + week for reproducibility across runs
Provide a privacy mode that applies deterministic hashing + token masking on identified entities (see privacy spec link)
Expose sampling knobs in Optimize recommendations: target bundle size, recency half-life, cluster quota, token-length distribution
design_tradeoffs: Reservoir vs stratified: reservoir with utility weights allows streaming from logs but requires careful bias correction; stratified sampling gives stronger guarantees for rare intents but is heavier to maintain across domains
Semantic clustering accuracy vs cost: higher cluster counts improve coverage of niche prompts but increase embed compute and memory; default set to 128 clusters per domain for balance
Privacy: masking aggressive policies reduce calibration signal for NER/PII-sensitive domains; we add a review step for those customers before accepting masked bundles for production calibration

experimental_results: Pilot domain: customer-support, bundle size 2,000, clusters=128. Utility-weighted reservoir retained 72% high-importance intents vs 58% for uniform reservoir.
INT8 calibration using pilot bundle produced mean latency unchanged and token-level repro within 0.7% of calibration baseline; quality delta +0.4% on intent accuracy metric
Privacy-mode masked bundles produced lower lexical overlap (expected) but intent coverage preserved at 90% with additional cluster quota relaxed
Edge case: domains with extremely sparse traffic (<200 requests/day) require fallback to cross-domain exemplars; implemented fallback to domain-tier cohort mixing (configurable)
risks_mitigation: Risk: Weighted reservoir biases toward long prompts because token_count correlates with utility. Mitigation: log scaling and per-length bucket quotas.
Risk: Semantic cluster drift over time. Mitigation: weekly reclustering with deterministic seed and stability check; if drift > threshold, trigger review.
Risk: PII leakage in bundles. Mitigation: privacy_mode, automated PII redaction, manual review for regulated customers, and signed manifests for audit.
Risk: Overfitting to recent traffic. Mitigation: tunable recency half-life and held-out evaluation using a static validation set per domain
qa_plan: Unit tests for alias table sampling and deterministic seed behavior
Integration test: end-to-end bundle generation from raw logs -> pack manifest -> calibration run (INT8/FP8) -> validation metrics
Canary: run on 3 low-risk domains and compare eval metrics vs baseline for 2 consecutive runs before enabling for more domains
Performance test: ensure sampling pipeline can process a week of logs for a high-traffic domain within 4 hours on the existing infra
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pilot): 3 domains, generate bundles weekly, monitor calibration deltas (2 weeks)
Phase 1: scale to top-50 domains, enable Optimize recommendations and expose knobs in Console (read-only) for internal teams
Phase 2: enable self-serve on-hosted API with defaults and privacy_mode option; add support ticket template for customers wanting custom quotas
Rollback: revert to previous calibration pack generator and invalidate any generated bundles via manifest revocation
